description: No styles anywhere. Chapters marked by a manual page break and a bare number.
whyItIsHard: The commonest real-world case. Nothing semantic to grab; detection rests entirely on page breaks plus short numeric lines.

description: Chapter number and title on separate lines.
whyItIsHard: Tests heading merging. A detector that treats these as two boundaries reports 48 chapters instead of 24.

description: Parts, chapters and two levels of section headings, all properly styled.
whyItIsHard: The well-behaved case. If this one fails, the bug is structural, not heuristic.

description: Heading 1 applied to chapters AND to sections inside them.
whyItIsHard: The case that breaks per-paragraph scoring. Both sets carry identical style signals; only spacing regularity and count separate them.

description: Hindi novel, chapters marked अध्याय N.
whyItIsHard: Devanagari script, Devanagari numerals in some headings, danda terminal punctuation.

description: Hindi body text with English chapter headings and quoted English passages.
whyItIsHard: Language spans matter here: without them the English quotes inherit Devanagari leading.

description: Poetry collection. Line breaks are semantic; poem titles are the chapter headings.
whyItIsHard: Verse lines are short and unpunctuated, which is exactly what a chapter heading looks like. Heavy false-positive pressure.

expected.note: 160 short unpunctuated verse lines must NOT become chapters.

description: Academic monograph: numbered chapters, tables, block quotes, long headings.
whyItIsHard: Long descriptive headings push against the length cutoff.

description: Exported from Google Docs. Heading styles present, no page breaks, extra empty paragraphs.
whyItIsHard: Google Docs never inserts pageBreakBefore, so that signal is absent entirely.

description: LibreOffice export. Custom style names, direct formatting on top.
whyItIsHard: Style names differ from Word's built-ins, so name matching alone misses them.

description: Chapter numbers spelled out, centred, no page breaks.
whyItIsHard: 'Chapter Seventeen' has no digits. Word-number matching required.

description: A very long manuscript. Render timing and detection at scale.
whyItIsHard: Roughly 900 printed pages. Time both the import and the render against this one.

description: Tabs for indentation, double spaces, all-caps headings, no styles.
whyItIsHard: Tab-indented paragraphs and manual spacing. Cleanup pass territory.

description: Chapters numbered with Roman numerals only.
whyItIsHard: 'I', 'V', 'X' are also ordinary words or initials in English. Ambiguity by design.

description: Extensive front and back matter around a short main text.
whyItIsHard: Named sections must map to block kinds, not become chapters.

expected.note: 7 named matter sections must be classified, not counted as chapters.

description: One continuous essay with no chapters at all.
whyItIsHard: Detection must fail gracefully to one block rather than inventing structure.

description: Chapter titles with no numbers, no styles, page break only.
whyItIsHard: Nothing numeric to anchor on. Signature consistency is the only signal.

description: Eighty short recipes, each a chapter.
whyItIsHard: High chapter count and short blocks. Pushes the count and mean-gap guards.

expected.note: Bulleted ingredient lines must not score as headings.

description: Scene breaks, epigraphs and emphasised one-line paragraphs.
whyItIsHard: Ornament lines and short italic lines are the classic false positives.

expected.note: 30 scene breaks and 10 bold centred closing lines are decoys.

description: The same author formatted chapters three different ways over three years.
whyItIsHard: Signature clustering fragments. This one is expected to need manual correction — the value is that the summary says so honestly.

expected.note: Partial detection is an acceptable pass; silent wrong confidence is not.
